# Pixenox

> Pixenox Solutions Pvt Ltd is an AI engineering company headquartered in India, operating three service lines: AI Systems Engineering, Enterprise Intelligence Engineering, and AI Visibility (Generative Engine Optimization). This file follows the llms.txt convention for AI- and LLM-readable site navigation. See llms-full.txt for expanded facts, definitions, and FAQs.

## Services
- [AI Systems Engineering](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-systems): Autonomous multi-agent systems, decision intelligence, and AI infrastructure engineering.
- [Enterprise Intelligence Engineering](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering): Enterprise data platform, systems integration, and cloud infrastructure engineering.
- [AI Visibility](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-visibility): Generative Engine Optimization — structured data, entity engineering, and AI citation monitoring.
